items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: We stayed Adelaide Hall's house in London.

ctx.x: up to get some help from Homemakers Chore. This is the girl that's sick. She finally has to go to the hospital. She goes to the hospital. Well, I began to (wolf) my ex-wife. I don't care. But during the course of time, I find out from this girl what her phone number was, what her address was and everything in Las Vegas. Found out she was married and found out she had a child, found out they're divorced. All this I found out from this poor girl, God rest her soul, she's dead. I ain't heard from the ex-wife yet. So…
We stayed Adelaide Hall's house in London. They had an apartment house. We stayed with them.

Oh, to tell you about it is terrific. In the episode of that marriage and that friendship death and the divorce and the separation. Now, brother, I had so many plays, so many moves in life -- so many.
